title: Fix JobPipelineFunnel.tsx — 12 TypeScript errors from undefined pipeline properties
description:
**File:** `dashboard/src/components/home/JobPipelineFunnel.tsx`

**Problem:** All pipeline properties (`pending`, `dispatched`, `running`, `succeeded`, `failed`) are typed as `number | undefined` from `GatewayStatus` (see `hooks/useStatus.ts` lines 38-44) but used in arithmetic without null-coalescing. This causes 12 TypeScript errors and potential NaN at runtime.

**Errors:**
- Line 62: `Math.max(0, pipeline.pending)` — pending is possibly undefined
- Lines 72-76: `pipeline.pending + pipeline.dispatched + ...` — all possibly undefined
- Line 79: `safetyCount + pipeline.dispatched + pipeline.running` — possibly undefined
- Lines 82, 85, 88, 91: direct assignment of possibly-undefined to `count: number`

**Fix:** Add `?? 0` to every pipeline property access:
```typescript
(pipeline.pending ?? 0)
(pipeline.dispatched ?? 0)
(pipeline.running ?? 0)
(pipeline.succeeded ?? 0)
(pipeline.failed ?? 0)
```
definitionOfDone: All 12 TypeScript errors in JobPipelineFunnel.tsx are resolved
Pipeline chart renders correctly when some properties are undefined

implementationPlan.description:
Add `?? 0` null-coalescing to all pipeline property accesses in JobPipelineFunnel.tsx. Specifically:

Line 62: `Math.max(0, (pipeline.pending ?? 0))`
Line 72: `(pipeline.pending ?? 0) +`
Line 73: `(pipeline.dispatched ?? 0) +`
Line 74: `(pipeline.running ?? 0) +`
Line 75: `(pipeline.succeeded ?? 0) +`
Line 76: `(pipeline.failed ?? 0);`
Line 79: `safetyCount + (pipeline.dispatched ?? 0) + (pipeline.running ?? 0);`
Line 82: `count = (pipeline.dispatched ?? 0);`
Line 85: `count = (pipeline.running ?? 0);`
Line 88: `count = (pipeline.succeeded ?? 0);`
Line 91: `count = (pipeline.failed ?? 0);`
Verify: run `node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit` from dashboard/ — confirm 0 errors from this file.
